prompt: Create a vertical anime illustration of Mei, a graceful young fox-girl shrine maiden in an elegant Japanese-inspired outfit. She has very long flowing glossy black-brown hair with straight bangs, soft brown eyes, a calm shy expression, faint blush, and two large upright black fox ears with pale inner fur. Add one thick braid falling over her chest and loose hair streaming down past her waist. Dress her in an off-white kimono-style top with wide sleeves, red embroidered floral borders, delicate lace-like trim, a dark red hakama skirt, and a large red obi bow decorated with subtle floral patterns; include small bracelets and a dark choker. Place an ornate red-and-gold floral hair ornament with dangling tassels on the left side of her head. The composition is a half-to-three-quarter body portrait, centered, slightly turned toward the viewer, with her hands near the lower edge. Use a warm cream, sepia, dusty rose, and deep red palette with soft watercolor shading and refined line art. The background should be a decorative Japanese postcard design: a cream paper texture, a red gingham square behind the head, a thin circular arc framing the character, cherry blossom branches and red flowers surrounding her, two hanging tassel ornaments in the upper left and upper right corners, and an ornamental red border with floral corner motifs. Include exactly one vertical tag label on the left side containing cursive text nana daya and a tiny paw print. Keep the image delicate, romantic, highly detailed, symmetrical in border decoration, no modern objects, no watermark.
